notes.title: WOLFMAN Reaches 400% Funding on Kickstarter – Join the Hunt!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245130/60e947389d48087ea7057628c95484dc8607aa77.png[/img]


Hunters, we have incredible news! Our Wolfman Kickstarter campaign has reached 400% of its funding goal, far exceeding our expectations! This amazing achievement was made possible by your support and enthusiasm. We are truly grateful to each and every one of you!

But the hunt isn’t over yet! If you haven’t joined the campaign yet, there’s still time to support us. Your backing on Kickstarter will help us enhance Wolfman even further and deliver the best possible experience.

We are also working hard to bring Wolfman to Early Access in March–April. With your feedback, we’ll continue improving the game and making it even more immersive.

Thank you to everyone who believes in us and has joined us on this journey! Don’t miss your chance to be part of the hunt—visit our Kickstarter page now!

▶ Support Us Here:  https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lithium-studios/wolfman-survival-horror-game-redefine-fear
